verdict.rationale: HMRC documents an agent rail: an agent can sign a taxpayer up for Making Tax Digital, and the supplementary note says agents have their own sign-up path and client-authorisation request links. The evidence is a single sentence on an Income Tax page aimed at sole traders and landlords, not a company-level delegation framework. Missing for 10: documentation of how agents are authorised to act for a limited company (Corporation Tax, VAT, PAYE), the scope and revocation of agent permissions, the authorisation workflow in detail, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: If you use an agent, they can sign you up instead.
agents hold their own sign-up path and client-authorisation request links.
